S0.name: exact-source
S0.description: Original source bytes or original source files recovered (embedded source maps with sourcesContent, or shipped source).

S1.name: near-source
S1.description: Decompiled source (Java/Kotlin, C#, JS/TS-like) with compiler transformations, lost comments/types or renamed symbols.

S2.name: pseudo-source
S2.description: Algorithmic pseudo-code from a native decompiler; useful for logic recovery, not compilable original source.

S3.name: assembly-metadata
S3.description: Disassembly, strings, resources, manifests, metadata and protocol observations; no source form.

S4.name: behavior-only
S4.description: Observed behavior only; internals remain unknown.

families.title: Android APK / DEX / resources
families.note: jadx yields Java/Kotlin source; apktool yields smali and decoded resources. Neither recovers original Kotlin/Java source exactly.

families.title: .NET / managed assembly
families.note: ILSpy-class decompilers reconstruct C# near-source; local ilspycmd not installed, REA MCP managed tools are the expected path.

families.title: Native PE / ELF / Mach-O
families.note: Optimized native code generally cannot be turned back into original source. Local tools disassemble; REA/Ghidra decomposes to pseudo-C.

families.title: Electron / ASAR / JavaScript
families.note: Embedded source maps with sourcesContent are the only reliable exact-source path; ASAR usually contains bundled JS, not original TS/JSX.

families.title: Firmware / embedded images
families.note: Firmware extraction recovers files and configs, rarely source. Encryption/compression may prevent extraction entirely.

families.title: JAR / ZIP / TAR / GZIP
families.note: Extraction preserves contained artifacts (including source if shipped); it is not decompilation.

families.title: Suspicious sample / forensic artifact
families.note: Static analysis only. The plugin never executes a target, never detonates it and never contacts C2 infrastructure.

policy.externalToolInvocation: only fixed trusted toolchain CLIs (jadx, apktool, objdump, readelf, strings, ilspycmd, binwalk, unblob, ghidra, dotnet) with structured argv, timeouts, output caps and no shell
